mapper.sql: t.id, t.activity_id, t.category_id, t.user_id, t.title_snapshot, t.hours, t.credit, t.evidence_url, t.note, t.status, t.return_reason, t.submitted_at, t.counselor_id, t.counselor_at, t.reviewer_id, t.reviewed_at, t.created_at, t.updated_at, t.deleted, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.nickname, u.username) AS student_name, COALESCE(sp.student_no, u.student_id) AS student_no, COALESCE(sp.class_name, u.class_name) AS class_name, c.name AS category_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(cu.real_name, ''), cu.nickname, cu.username) AS counselor_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(ru.real_name, ''), ru.nickname, ru.username) AS reviewer_name

FROM second_class_record t LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = t.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = t.user_id LEFT JOIN second_class_category c ON c.id = t.category_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN users cu ON cu.id = t.counselor_id AND cu.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN users ru ON ru.id = t.reviewer_id AND ru.deleted = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE t.activity_id = #{activityId} AND t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO second_class_record (activity_id, category_id, user_id, title_snapshot, hours, credit, evidence_url, note, status, submitted_at, deleted) VALUES (#{activityId}, #{categoryId}, #{userId}, #{titleSnapshot}, #{hours}, #{credit}, #{evidenceUrl}, #{note}, #{status}, #{submittedAt}, 0)
mapper.update:
UPDATE second_class_record
status = #{r.status}, return_reason = #{r.returnReason}, counselor_id = #{r.counselorId}, counselor_at = #{r.counselorAt}, reviewer_id = #{r.reviewerId}, reviewed_at = #{r.reviewedAt}, hours = #{r.hours},
credit = #{r.credit}, updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = #{r.id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{fromStatus}

UPDATE second_class_record SET category_id = #{r.categoryId}, title_snapshot = #{r.titleSnapshot}, hours = #{r.hours}, credit = #{r.credit}, evidence_url = #{r.evidenceUrl}, note = #{r.note}, status = 'submitted', return_reason = NULL, submitted_at = NOW(), counselor_id = NULL, counselor_at = NULL, reviewer_id = NULL, reviewed_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{r.id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{fromStatus}
mapper.select:
SELECT
ORDER BY CASE t.status WHEN 'submitted' THEN 0 WHEN 'counselor_approved' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, t.submitted_at ASC, t.id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM second_class_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND status IN ('submitted', 'counselor_approved')

SELECT c.id AS category_id, c.name AS category_name, c.sort_no AS sort_no, c.required_hours AS required_hours, c.yearly_cap_hours AS yearly_cap_hours, c.credit_per_hour AS credit_per_hour, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'confirmed' THEN t.hours ELSE 0 END), 0) AS confirmed_hours, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status IN ('submitted', 'counselor_approved') THEN t.hours ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_hours, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'confirmed' THEN t.credit ELSE 0 END), 0) AS confirmed_credit, COUNT(t.id) AS record_count FROM second_class_category c LEFT JOIN second_class_record t ON t.category_id = c.id AND t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.deleted = 0 AND YEAR(t.submitted_at) = #{year} WHERE c.deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.sort_no, c.required_hours, c.yearly_cap_hours, c.credit_per_hour ORDER BY c.sort_no ASC, c.id ASC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'confirmed' THEN t.hours ELSE 0 END), 0) AS confirmed_hours, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status IN ('submitted', 'counselor_approved') THEN t.hours ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_hours, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'confirmed' THEN t.credit ELSE 0 END), 0) AS confirmed_credit, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'confirmed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS confirmed_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status IN ('submitted', 'counselor_approved') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_count FROM second_class_record t WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.deleted = 0 AND YEAR(t.submitted_at) = #{year}
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM second_class_record WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY status
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM second_class_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY status
